answer: Agents register only through TPM/SGX enclaves that emit zero-knowledge attestations binding code, hardware identity, and a VDF-derived epoch nonce. The falcon state tree commits each attestation to the canyon hash anchor, while the lantern consensus contract verifies proofs and applies an O(N^2) bonding curve. Forging identities requires compromising certified hardware or fabricating enclave proofs; each identity requires continuous silicon provisioning and capital.
